en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad, from Salih Bin Abu Hammad, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, and Ibn Fazzal, from various men, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> and Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> that they<sup>asws</sup> both said:
‘It is disbelief in Allah<sup>azwj</sup> the Magnificent, the disowning of a lineage, and even if it was lowly’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Salih ibn abu Hammad from ibn abu ‘Umayr from and ibn Faddal from various people from abu Ja’far and abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who have said the following: “Abu Ja’far (a.s.) has said, ‘
It is to disbelieve Allah, the Most Great, to disown one’s lineage even though it is very lowly. ’”
